title: I had ...
description: A picture lesson on the verb 'have' in the past tense (eat, drink, or be engaged in an activity). Students listen to a recording and answer a question, then study twelve numbered pictures (760-1,090) showing meals, a swim, a bath, a haircut, a lesson, a party, a holiday and a good time. Written exercises ask students to rewrite sentences using drank / enjoyed yourself / are eating / went for / ate / take, and to answer questions using going to have / having / must have / had. Workbook practice covers personal questions about the verb 'have' and open-ended situation responses. Grammar exercises combine two clauses with 'but ... didn't have' and make sentences using the short forms 'and I did, too / but we aren't / but ... can't'.
answer_note: Lesson listening question is a suggested model answer based on the pictures. Written A (rewrite using the verbs given) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-6 are suggested model answers. Written B (answer using going to have / having / must have / had) 12 items are suggested model answers following the printed example pattern. Practice A (about you: the verb have) 8 items are open-ended; the key (img/key-080-085.jpg) supplies possible answers, which are used here. Practice B (situations) 3 items are suggested model answers. Grammar I (answer the questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 512-513). Grammar II (make sentences) items 1-2 are printed examples; items 3-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 512-513). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the questions.

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the recording.

questions.prompt: What did you have for breakfast today?
questions.answer: I had a cup of coffee and a biscuit for breakfast today.

lesson.title: Written A — Rewrite using the verbs given
lesson.instruction:
A Rewrite these sentences using drank, enjoyed yourself, are eating, went for, ate or take. 模仿例句完成以下句子，选用 drank, enjoyed yourself, are eating, went for, ate 或 take。
Example: I had a cup of coffee. → I drank a cup of coffee.
lesson.translation: Rewrite each sentence using one of the verbs given, following the example.

questions.prompt: Example: I had a cup of coffee.
questions.answer: I drank a cup of coffee.

questions.prompt: They had a meal at a restaurant.
questions.answer: They ate a meal at a restaurant.

questions.prompt: We had a holiday last month.
questions.answer: We went for a holiday last month.

questions.prompt: Have a biscuit.
questions.answer: Take a biscuit.

questions.prompt: You had a good time.
questions.answer: You enjoyed yourself.

questions.prompt: They are having their lunch.
questions.answer: They are eating their lunch.

lesson.title: Written B — Answer using going to have / having / must have / had
lesson.instruction:
B Answer these questions using going to have, having, must have or had. 模仿例句回答以下问题，选用恰当的动词和动词时态。
Example: What is he going to do? (a glass of whisky) → He's going to have a glass of whisky.
lesson.translation: Answer each question using the correct form of 'have', following the example.

questions.prompt: What are they going to do? (breakfast)
questions.answer: They're going to have breakfast.

questions.prompt: What are they doing? (lunch)
questions.answer: They're having lunch.

questions.prompt: What must he do? (tea)
questions.answer: He must have tea.

questions.prompt: What did they do? (dinner)
questions.answer: They had dinner.

questions.prompt: What must they do? (a meal)
questions.answer: They must have a meal.

questions.prompt: What is he going to do? (a swim)
questions.answer: He's going to have a swim.

questions.prompt: What is he doing? (a bath)
questions.answer: He's having a bath.

questions.prompt: What did he do? (a haircut)
questions.answer: He had a haircut.

questions.prompt: What are they doing? (a lesson)
questions.answer: They're having a lesson.

questions.prompt: What did they do? (a party)
questions.answer: They had a party.

questions.prompt: What must they do? (a holiday)
questions.answer: They must have a holiday.

questions.prompt: What are they going to do? (a good time)
questions.answer: They're going to have a good time.

practice.title: A — About you: the verb 'have'
practice.instruction: Answer these questions with full sentences. 用完整的句子回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Answer each question with a full sentence about yourself.
practice.context: These are open-ended personal questions. The key (img/key-080-085.jpg) supplies possible model answers, which are used here.

questions.prompt: 1. When do you usually have breakfast?
questions.answer: I / We usually have breakfast at 6.30 a.m.

questions.prompt: 2. What do you usually have for lunch?
questions.answer: I usually have a snack.

questions.prompt: 3. When do you usually have dinner?
questions.answer: I / We usually have dinner at 7.

questions.prompt: 4. How often do you have a haircut?
questions.answer: I have a haircut every month.

questions.prompt: 5. When did you last have a haircut?
questions.answer: I last had a haircut two weeks ago.

questions.prompt: 6. When (in the week) do you have English lessons?
questions.answer: We have English lessons on Tuesday and Thursday.

questions.prompt: 7. Did you have a holiday last year? Where did you go?
questions.answer: We had a holiday last year in [place].

questions.prompt: 8. When did you have a party? What was it for?
questions.answer: I had a party for my last birthday.

practice.title: B — Situations
practice.instruction: Read each situation carefully. What do you say? 仔细阅读每个情景，写出你可能会说的话。
practice.translation: Read each situation and write what you would say.

questions.prompt: 1. You are going out with an English-speaking friend. He / She asks if you are ready. You are — almost.
questions.answer: I'm nearly ready.

questions.prompt: 2. A friend looks ill, or worried, or something. You want to know what's wrong.
questions.answer: What's the matter?

questions.prompt: 3. A friend says he / she hasn't got much money. Nor have you. How do you agree?
questions.answer: Well, I haven't got much (money) either.

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=249
grammar.title: I. Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
Example: 1. Did you have breakfast and lunch at the hotel? → We had breakfast, but we didn't have lunch.
grammar.translation: Answer each question, combining the two parts with 'but ... didn't have', following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=512
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 512-513).

questions.prompt: 1. Did you have breakfast and lunch at the hotel?
questions.answer: We had breakfast, but we didn't have lunch.

questions.prompt: 2. Did they have wine and beer at the party?
questions.answer: They had wine, but they didn't have beer.

questions.prompt: 3. Did he have tea and dinner yesterday?
questions.answer: He had tea, but he didn't have dinner.

questions.prompt: 4. Did you have a party and a holiday last month?
questions.answer: I/We had a party, but I/we didn't have a holiday.

questions.prompt: 5. Did she have a lesson and a meeting yesterday afternoon?
questions.answer: She had a lesson, but she didn't have a meeting.

questions.prompt: 6. Did you have a haircut and some new shoes last week?
questions.answer: I had a haircut, but I didn't have any new shoes.

questions.prompt: 7. Did they have an English lesson and a German lesson on Monday?
questions.answer: They had an English lesson, but they didn't have a German lesson.

questions.prompt: 8. Did you have some biscuits and a glass of milk?
questions.answer: I had some biscuits, but I didn't have a glass of milk.

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=250
grammar.title: II. Make sentences according to the examples. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction:
Make sentences according to the examples. 仿照例句造句。
Example 1: Sam and Ann / roast beef / for dinner / yesterday → Sam had roast beef for dinner yesterday, and Ann did, too.
Example 2: I / usually / milk / in the morning / he / not → I usually have milk in the morning, but he doesn't.
grammar.translation: Make a sentence from each set of cues, following the example patterns.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=512
grammar.context: Items 1-2 are printed examples (not editable). Items 3-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 512-513).

questions.prompt: 1. Sam and Ann / roast beef / for dinner / yesterday
questions.answer: Sam had roast beef for dinner yesterday, and Ann did, too.

questions.prompt: 2. I / usually / milk / in the morning / he / not
questions.answer: I usually have milk in the morning, but he doesn't.

questions.prompt: 3. you and I / a swim / in the sea / the day before yesterday
questions.answer: You had a swim in the sea the day before yesterday, and I did, too.

questions.prompt: 4. they / a holiday / now / we / not
questions.answer: They are having a holiday now, but we aren't.

questions.prompt: 5. Sam / can / a glass of beer / his son / not
questions.answer: Sam can have a glass of beer, but his son can't.

questions.prompt: 6. she and you / must / a lesson / now
questions.answer: She must have a lesson now, and you must, too.

questions.prompt: 7. Mr. Scott / a bad day / yesterday / Mrs. Scott / not
questions.answer: Mr. Scott had a bad day yesterday, but Mrs. Scott didn't.

questions.prompt: 8. you and we / a good time / at the party / last night
questions.answer: You had a good time at the party last night, and we did, too.

questions.prompt: 9. my friend and I / a walk / along the beach / every evening
questions.answer: My friend has a walk along the beach every evening, and I do, too.

questions.prompt: 10. Jill / usually / lunch / at home / Jim / not
questions.answer: Jill usually has lunch at home, but Jim doesn't.
